tags: @guarantee ok.api returns a store exposing `setState`, `getState`, `getInitialState` and `subscribe`
@guarantee ok.initial `getState` and `getInitialState` return the state the state creator returned, before any update
@guarantee ok.merge `setState` with an object shallow-merges it into the current state by default
@guarantee ok.replace `setState` with `replace` true replaces the state with the given one
@guarantee ok.updater `setState` with a function calls it with the current state and merges what it returns
@guarantee ok.subscribe a listener passed to `subscribe` is called whenever the state updates, and the function `subscribe` returns removes it
@guarantee ok.primitives for primitive values returns true when they are the same value and false otherwise, like `Object.is`
@guarantee ok.objects for two objects returns true when they have the same top-level keys and each top-level value is the same by reference
@guarantee ok.nested returns false when a top-level value is a different object with equal contents
@guarantee ok.prototype returns false when the two objects have different prototypes
@guarantee ok.sets for two Sets returns true when they hold the same entries
@guarantee ok.maps for two Maps returns true when they hold the same keys mapped to the same values
@guarantee ok.json reads values with `JSON.parse` and writes them with `JSON.stringify` through the storage the getter returns
@guarantee ok.lazy the getter is called only when the storage is first accessed, not when `createJSONStorage` is called
@guarantee ok.name the state is written to the storage under the key `name`
@guarantee ok.shape the stored value holds the state and the `version`
@guarantee ok.default-storage without `storage`, uses `createJSONStorage` over `localStorage`
@guarantee ok.partialize with `partialize`, only the state it returns is persisted
@guarantee ok.version a stored state whose version differs from `version` is not used as is
@guarantee ok.migrate when the versions differ, `migrate` is called with the persisted state and its version, and its result is used
@guarantee ok.merge without `merge`, the persisted state is shallow-merged into the current state on rehydration
@guarantee ok.skip-hydration `skipHydration` defaults to false; when true, the state is not rehydrated on initialisation until `rehydrate` is called
@guarantee ok.on-rehydrate `onRehydrateStorage` is called before rehydration, and the function it returns is called after it
